description: Show an upload panel in the conversation for custom die-cut sticker artwork that has no public image URL. If the image is in this conversation — uploaded by the customer or generated by you — pass it as artwork: the panel then opens with it already loaded and an "Order these stickers" button that opens the Bottle Your Brand order page with the artwork attached. Without artwork the panel shows a drop zone for a file on their device. Prefer order_custom_stickers when a public https image URL is available.

artwork.description: The image from this conversation the customer wants printed: one they uploaded or one you generated. Pass it whenever such an image exists, so the panel opens with it already loaded. Leave it out only when there is no image in the conversation.

name: upload_sticker_artwork

load_error.description: Why a chat image could not be loaded; the panel shows it.

product.description: Product key the upload panel orders for.

ready.description: Pre-loaded artwork; when present the panel shows it ready to order.

upload_url.description: Page to use if the panel cannot be shown.

title: Upload sticker artwork
